verdict.rationale: Tilled documents generating API keys through the Dashboard. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, restricted to specific permissions or resources, or issued as least-privilege credentials for an agent, so generic API keys do not deliver the story. Missing for 10: documented scoped or restricted API keys, permission or role granularity for keys, and any agent-specific least-privilege credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
